elen (People Ops): @here Quick manager checkpoint — updated timeline + manager checklist for this review cycle. Please read and acknowledge. :calendar:

elen (People Ops): Key dates: `Peer feedback due: 2026-03-31`, `Manager reviews due: 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT`, `Calibration window: 2026-04-13 to 2026-04-17`, `Final ratings locked: 2026-04-24`. If you need a change, follow the extension flow below. :clock1:

elen (People Ops): Manager checklist (do these in this order):
1) Confirm direct report list in Lattice -> `People > My team`
2) Read recent goal updates and 1:1 notes (last 6 months)
3) Complete written manager review + recommended rating in the review form (`https://intranet.redwood/hr/review-form`)
4) Add 1–2 calibration notes explaining edge cases (if any) — see template below
5) Submit before the due date, then reserve 10–20m with your peer calibration group (calendar invites will appear)

elen (People Ops): Quick manager note template (paste into the "Calibration notes" field):
```
Context: [product / infra / team changes]
Observed impact: [metrics, shipped projects, customer feedback]
Level justification: [examples that support rating]
Risks or stretch areas: [what to watch next cycle]
```

sam (Eng Manager): Thanks @elen — one quick Q: my manager will be out 04/08-04/12. Can we get an extension for those reports? :thinking:

maya (People Ops): Short answer: yes, in some cases. Policy: we allow a single, manager-level extension of up to 48 hours for excused leaves (medical, PTO overlap, travel) but calibration schedules are tight. For anything >48h or schedule-critical (director-level signoffs), you must escalate to people-ops (reply to this thread and we'll triage). To request, fill: `https://intranet.redwood/hr/extension-request` and cc your manager.

sam (Eng Manager): Cool — I'll submit the form now. Appreciate the clarity. :+1:

jamal (Director, Eng): Quick ask on calibration rubric: do we have explicit definitions for "Exceeds / Meets / Below"? Some teams are diverging in interpretation.

elen (People Ops): Great point — short rubric we will use in calibration:
- Exceeds Expectations: Consistent outsized impact vs role level; clearly measurable output; demonstrates ownership beyond scope.
- Meets Expectations: Reliable delivery against goals, solid craftsmanship, collaborates well; no sustained performance gaps.
- Below Expectations: Repeated missed commitments or skill gaps that materially affect team outcomes.

elen (People Ops): In calibration, we'll prioritize impact examples and customer/metric evidence. If a rating is controversial, add a 2–3 sentence note referencing specific artifacts (PRs, issues, customer threads).

luca (Recruiter): One operational snag — if a hiring freeze affects comp discussions during calibration, should managers flag candidates or open offers?

maya (People Ops): Flag them in the calibration notes and tag me @maya. We'll keep hiring ops separate from individual rating conversations, but any comp-impacting decisions need early alignment with People Ops + Finance.

hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager review due in 7 days" will post to each manager DM at 2026-04-03 09:00 PDT.

elen (People Ops): Final mini-check before you leave this thread: paste the manager note template into each review, attach any supporting links, and RSVP to your calibration session when the invite arrives. If you run into any weirdness (form errors, missing employees), ping this channel or DM @maya. :eyes: 

sam (Eng Manager): Acknowledge — will do. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
